source_facts.facts: Dual-slidable solution claims 2.5 mm radius and targets ultra-thin portable laptop displays.
Flexible OLED technology description includes slidable phones.
Flexible AMOLED capabilities include foldable, slidable and rollable through layered structures and stress management.

RA copper starting bend ratios use total composite including coverlay/bondply/shield: 6x for one/two layers and 12x for three-plus. Grain and plating matter. Unbonded sections can press into each other; air gaps/crosshatching require impedance review.
Approximate 10x thickness guide; solid copper shield stiffens flex, silver shield is discouraged for dynamic flex. Stagger conductors rather than stacked I-beam layout.
Dynamic recommendation is 12x overall thickness. Pad/transition separation from fold line 0.76 mm; plated holes outside bend region and selective plating for flexibility.

Dynamic application needs its own material/layer/copper/plating/radius/cycle design. FAQ specifies single-layer for dynamic flex. Manufacturing requires full artwork, layerstack, controlled dimensions/tolerances, netlist and testing.

Neutral bend plane is distinct from outer tension/inner compression layers. Material and handling affect cracks, tears, wrinkling and delamination; conductor staggering and unbonding have design limits.
